إِرْدَبَّةٌ A wide بَالُوعَة [or sink-hole] made of baked clay: (T, K:) likened to the مِكْيَال above mentioned: pl. as above. (T.) [And Any pipe of baked clay: pl. إِرْدَبَّاتٌ: see دَاخِنَةٌ.] ―
-b2- And i. q. قِرْمِيدَةٌ [which may mean A large baked brick, or a thing made of baked clay]: (M, TA:) or large baked bricks; (S, K, TA;) which are called قِرْمِيدٌ. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
